svg.title: Wallets on seven possible paths
svg.desc: Seven charts show the median simulated wallet every five active minutes over 40 hours. The dashed line marks the $2 million current-cash property market gate. Purchases lower cash, and the median does not track one individual. Courier: 250/250 first homes, median 18.3 hours; Explorer: 250/250 first homes, median 21.4 hours; Dome player: 250/250 first homes, median 19.7 hours; Dome player, no wins: 250/250 first homes, median 28.5 hours; Racer and parker: 250/250 first homes, median 18.8 hours; Cab operator: 250/250 first homes, median 15.3 hours; Mixed activities: 250/250 first homes, median 16.4 hours. These are proposed rules, not player telemetry.

g.text: Median · 250 runs per path · bonuses off
Each point is a median, not one player.
Balanced candidate; events off. Simulated data.
